summary.key_theme: 公司近期財報表現強勁且獲分析師調升目標價，但受整體軟體類股 AI 估值修正與市場波動影響，股價呈現多空拉鋸。

bullish.title: Wells Fargo Maintains Overweight on ServiceNow, Raises Price Target to $175
bullish.reason: Wells Fargo 分析師 Michael Turrin 維持「加碼」評級，並將目標價調升至 175 美元，顯示對公司長期成長潛力的信心。

bullish.title: Wall Street May Be Sleeping on This AI Growth Story, The Stock Has 97% Upside
bullish.reason: 報導指出 ServiceNow 財報表現優異，且相較於 52 週高點仍有顯著折價，具備強勁的 AI 成長動能與估值修復空間。

bullish.title: Is ServiceNow (NOW) a Buy as Wall Street Analysts Look Optimistic?
bullish.reason: 平均經紀商建議 (ABR) 維持在「買入」區間，反映華爾街對該公司基本面與獲利能力的普遍看好。

bullish.title: What’s Going On With ServiceNow (NOW)?
bullish.reason: 公司第二季財報營收與獲利均優於預期，展現強勁的營運韌性，為股價提供基本面支撐。

bullish.title: NOW Stock Has Rebounded Over 54% — Why ServiceNow’s Rally Could Have Further Room to Run
bullish.reason: 股價近期強勁反彈 54%，技術面與基本面動能顯示漲勢可能延續。

bullish.title: Brightfin Helps Federal Agencies Plan IT Finances Faster and Cut Telecom Costs Through Knox’s FedRAMP Platform
bullish.reason: 透過與 Brightfin 合作，擴展 ServiceNow 在聯邦政府 IT 支出管理市場的應用，有助於提升市占率。

bullish.title: ServiceNow CFO: Trillions are being spent on AI initiatives.
bullish.reason: CFO 強調 AI 支出趨勢，強化市場對公司在企業 AI 轉型中扮演關鍵角色的認知。

bullish.title: RXO, BrightView, SiteOne, ServiceNow, and Rocket Lab Shares Are Soaring
bullish.reason: 受宏觀經濟數據（就業報告）影響，市場情緒轉向，帶動包括 ServiceNow 在內的多檔科技股上漲。

bearish.title: ServiceNow (NOW) Stock Still Looks Expensive Despite A 30% Fall
bearish.reason: 儘管股價已下跌 30%，但分析認為其估值相對於成長預期仍顯昂貴，存在修正壓力。

bearish.title: ServiceNow: It Is Time To Downgrade Amidst AI Overhang
bearish.reason: 市場對 AI 相關支出的不確定性增加，分析師建議降評以規避潛在的估值過高風險。

bearish.title: Rapid7, ServiceNow, and monday.com Shares Are Falling
bearish.reason: 軟體類股近期普遍面臨賣壓，反映市場對高估值軟體公司獲利成長放緩的擔憂。

bearish.title: Palantir and Microsoft Drop. Why the AI Revival Is Hitting Software Stocks.
bearish.reason: 整體 AI 軟體板塊受大盤修正拖累，導致 ServiceNow 同步出現短期股價波動。

bearish.title: Claude AI Just Sold ServiceNow and Inter & Co
bearish.reason: AI Finance Labs 追蹤的投資組合賣出 ServiceNow，可能引發部分跟隨型投資者的賣壓。

bearish.title: ServiceNow: Great Company At A Fair Price, But I Need More Margin Of Safety
bearish.reason: 分析指出公司基本面良好，但目前股價缺乏足夠的安全邊際，建議投資人保持觀望。

neutral.title: NowVertical Group Announces Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date
neutral.reason: 僅為例行性的財報發布日期公告，對股價無直接影響。

neutral.title: Jim Cramer Compares Enterprise Software Dynamics in Workday and ServiceNow
neutral.reason: Jim Cramer 針對企業軟體產業進行比較分析，未對 ServiceNow 提出明確的買賣建議。

neutral.title: FJTSY or NOW: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
neutral.reason: 僅為兩檔股票的價值比較分析，未提供具體的投資決策建議。

neutral.title: ServiceNow (NOW) Is Spending $7.75 Billion On AI Security
neutral.reason: 報導公司在 AI 安全領域的投入，屬於長期策略布局，短期對財務影響中性。
